configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Optimised + symbols. This is the config the DAW loads -- a Debug VST3 is ~10x slower per sample and leaves jasserts armed (a fired jassert is a SIGTRAP that takes the host down).

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised, jasserts armed. For gdb on the Standalone or the test binary ONLY -- never load this VST3 into a DAW.

configurePresets.name: sanitize
configurePresets.description: Debug + AddressSanitizer/UBSan, for running the test suite. Catches what the suite cannot assert on -- use-after-free, out-of-bounds, UB.
